calendar_events.title: Cervical Cancer Awareness Month
calendar_events.description: January highlights cervical cancer prevention and early detection. Share information about HPV vaccination and screening based on local clinical guidance.

calendar_events.title: Rare Disease Day
calendar_events.description: Held on the last day of February to raise awareness of rare diseases and their impact. Share patient perspectives with consent and explain routes to specialist support.

calendar_events.title: World Hearing Day
calendar_events.description: Promotes ear and hearing care and prevention of hearing loss. Share safe-listening advice and signs that warrant a hearing assessment.

calendar_events.title: World Oral Health Day
calendar_events.description: Highlights the importance of oral health throughout life. Publish practical brushing advice and explain when to seek dental care.

calendar_events.title: World Tuberculosis Day
calendar_events.description: Raises awareness of tuberculosis and efforts to end the disease. Explain symptoms, testing and treatment while addressing stigma.

calendar_events.title: World Autism Awareness Day
calendar_events.description: A UN observance focused on autistic people's rights and inclusion. Feature autistic voices and practical ways to make healthcare more accessible.

calendar_events.title: World Health Day
calendar_events.description: Marks the anniversary of the World Health Organization's founding. Highlight local health priorities and practical steps toward equitable access to care.

calendar_events.title: World Immunization Week
calendar_events.description: Observed April 24–30 to promote protection against vaccine-preventable diseases. Answer common vaccine questions and direct audiences to local vaccination schedules.

calendar_events.title: World Malaria Day
calendar_events.description: Highlights global efforts to prevent and control malaria. Share prevention guidance and encourage destination-specific medical advice before travel.

calendar_events.title: World Hand Hygiene Day
calendar_events.description: A WHO-led observance emphasizing hand hygiene in healthcare. Demonstrate effective technique and explain its role in preventing infections.

calendar_events.title: International Nurses Day
calendar_events.description: Recognizes nurses' contributions on Florence Nightingale's birth anniversary. Spotlight nursing roles, professional expertise and staff wellbeing.

calendar_events.title: World No Tobacco Day
calendar_events.description: Raises awareness of tobacco's health harms and supports tobacco control. Share evidence-based quitting resources and available cessation services.

calendar_events.title: World Blood Donor Day
calendar_events.description: Thanks voluntary blood donors and highlights the need for safe blood supplies. Explain local eligibility requirements and how to book a donation.

calendar_events.title: World Hepatitis Day
calendar_events.description: Promotes awareness and action on viral hepatitis. Explain prevention, testing and treatment options without stigmatizing affected communities.

calendar_events.title: World Breastfeeding Week
calendar_events.description: Observed August 1–7 to promote breastfeeding and supportive environments. Highlight skilled feeding support and compassionate, individualized care for families.

calendar_events.title: World Suicide Prevention Day
calendar_events.description: Promotes collective action to prevent suicide. Share supportive conversation guidance and verified local crisis resources using sensitive, non-sensational language.

calendar_events.title: World Patient Safety Day
calendar_events.description: A WHO observance focused on reducing avoidable harm in healthcare. Explain how patients and care teams can communicate concerns and improve safety together.

calendar_events.title: World Alzheimer's Day
calendar_events.description: Raises awareness of Alzheimer's disease and dementia. Share guidance on seeking assessment and highlight support for people living with dementia and their carers.

calendar_events.title: World Heart Day
calendar_events.description: Promotes cardiovascular health and prevention of heart disease and stroke. Share practical information about blood pressure, physical activity and tobacco cessation.

calendar_events.title: World Mental Health Day
calendar_events.description: Raises awareness of mental health and access to support. Explain available services and challenge misconceptions about seeking help.

calendar_events.title: World Stroke Day
calendar_events.description: Highlights stroke prevention, treatment and recovery. Teach locally recommended stroke warning signs and emphasize calling emergency services immediately.

calendar_events.title: World Diabetes Day
calendar_events.description: Raises awareness of diabetes and equitable access to care. Explain different diabetes types and share practical resources for ongoing management.

calendar_events.title: World AMR Awareness Week
calendar_events.description: Observed November 18–24 to raise awareness of antimicrobial resistance. Explain why antibiotics do not treat viral infections and promote appropriate antimicrobial use.

calendar_events.title: World AIDS Day
calendar_events.description: Unites communities in responding to HIV and remembering those lost to AIDS-related illnesses. Share accurate information about testing, prevention and treatment while challenging stigma.

calendar_events.title: World Cancer Day
calendar_events.description: A global observance promoting cancer prevention, detection and care. Highlight patient support services and ways to reduce barriers to treatment.
